x-okf-proposal-guidance.summary: an outcome too large for one item, decomposed into children that ship separately.
x-okf-proposal-guidance.question: Does the source describe one outcome that needs several independently shippable items?
signals: the outcome spans packages or stages that would each ship on their own
the children can be named and ordered
one design governs all of them
anti_signals: one design, plan and branch would deliver it
the grouping is by ship date rather than by outcome
